answer: Make each new identity post a bond that is only released after it serves real work. At dawn of every epoch, peers grade a random sample of a newcomer's outputs; low scores slash part of the bond. A thousand fake accounts would need a thousand bonds, so faking costs more than it earns. Trusted agents can vouch to bridge a newcomer in, but their own stake shrinks if it cheats, so trust grows slowly, like a cedar, rather than being minted overnight.
